class.name: OcgAISPlane
class.brief_description: Constructs plane datums to be used in construction of composite shapes.
class.description: ! Constructs plane datums to be used in construction of ! composite shapes.

method.name: from_1
method.description: initializes the plane aComponent. If the mode aCurrentMode equals true, the drawing tool, "Drawer" is not initialized.

method.name: from_2
method.description: initializes the plane aComponent and the point aCenter. If the mode aCurrentMode equals true, the drawing tool, "Drawer" is not initialized. aCurrentMode equals true, the drawing tool, "Drawer" is not initialized.

method.name: from_4
method.description: initializes the plane aComponent, the point aCenter, and the minimum and maximum points, aPmin and aPmax. If the mode aCurrentMode equals true, the drawing tool, "Drawer" is not initialized.

method.name: SetSize_1
method.description: Same value for x and y directions

method.name: SetSize_2
method.description: Sets the size defined by the length along the X axis XVal and the length along the Y axis YVal.

method.name: SetMinimumSize
method.description: Sets transform persistence for zoom with value of minimum size

method.name: UnsetMinimumSize
method.description: Unsets transform persistence zoom

method.name: HasMinimumSize
method.description: Returns true if transform persistence for zoom is set

method.name: Component
method.description: Returns the component specified in SetComponent.

method.name: SetComponent
method.description: Creates an instance of the plane aComponent.

method.name: PlaneAttributes
method.description: Returns the settings for the selected plane aComponent, provided in SetPlaneAttributes. These include the points aCenter, aPmin, and aPmax

method.name: SetPlaneAttributes
method.description: Allows you to provide settings other than default ones for the selected plane. These include: center point aCenter, maximum aPmax and minimum aPmin.

method.name: Center
method.description: Returns the coordinates of the center point.

method.name: SetCenter
method.description: Provides settings for the center theCenter other than (0, 0, 0).

method.name: SetAxis2Placement
method.description: Allows you to provide settings for the position and direction of one of the plane's axes, aComponent, in 3D space. The coordinate system used is right-handed, and the type of plane aPlaneType is one of: - AIS_ TOPL_Unknown - AIS_ TOPL_XYPlane - AIS_ TOPL_XZPlane - AIS_ TOPL_YZPlane}.

method.name: Axis2Placement
method.description: Returns the position of the plane's axis2 system identifying the x, y, or z axis and giving the plane a direction in 3D space. An axis2 system is a right-handed coordinate system.

method.name: TypeOfPlane
method.description: Returns the type of plane - xy, yz, xz or unknown.

method.name: IsXYZPlane
method.description: Returns the type of plane - xy, yz, or xz.

method.name: CurrentMode
method.description: Returns the non-default current display mode set by SetCurrentMode.

method.name: SetCurrentMode
method.description: Allows you to provide settings for a non-default current display mode.

method.name: AcceptDisplayMode
method.description: Returns true if the display mode selected, aMode, is valid for planes.

method.name: SetContext
method.description: connection to <aCtx> default drawer implies a recomputation of Frame values.

method.name: TypeOfSensitivity
method.description: Returns the type of sensitivity for the plane;

method.name: SetTypeOfSensitivity
method.description: Sets the type of sensitivity for the plane.
